description: Search Google Play or App Store apps by keyword (live results). Returns app ids, titles, developers, ratings and prices, each with an apppage_url page that has full details. Use get_app for details of one app.

country.description: Optional two-letter ISO 3166 store country code (e.g. US, GB, TR, DE). Defaults to US.

query.description: Search keywords, e.g. "photo editor" or an app name.

store.description: Which store: google_play (Android, default) or app_store (iPhone/iPad).

name: search_apps
title: Search apps
